name: Figma
description: Figma is a collaborative interface design tool that allows teams to create, prototype, and share designs seamlessly. It is widely used by designers and developers to work together in real-time, making the design process more efficient and effective.

events.d: Add a comment to a Figma file, pin it to a spot on the canvas, or reply to an existing comment.
Add an emoji reaction to a Figma comment using its link or ID.
Remove your emoji reaction from a Figma comment using its link or ID.
Remove a specific comment from a Figma file.
Fix layer-link visibility and require the layer link or file and node ID in their selected input mode; preserve code and mappings.
Runs when a new comment or reply is posted in a chosen file.
